title: Plan safe deterministic profile application
description:
Pure profile planning converts the embedded package plus repository snapshot into exact final bytes/modes, semantic registry and managed-region merges, conflicts, overlay validation input, and a stable dry-run plan without mutation.

## Background

The profile MVP must calculate and validate its complete result before staging. The planner stays domain-pure and contains no dogfood vocabulary, repository writes, or deferred lifecycle concepts.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: For map entries, set-like strings, keyed array tables, and root singleton tables, absence adds, canonical structural equality is a no-op, differing same-identity values conflict, deletions/overrides/partial singleton merges are forbidden, existing comments/order remain, and new values append in manifest order.
- [hard] REQ-02: Assets and managed regions preserve identical/unmanaged bytes and reject differing files, unknown contribution identities, malformed markers, unsafe/overlapping paths, symlink escapes, invalid interpolation, and unsupported filesystem assumptions before staging.
- [hard] REQ-03: Planning is input-order deterministic, validates exact output through the shared overlay view, contains no dogfood vocabulary/source-checkout access, and exposes identities for locked rebuild.

## Scope

**Blast radius:** profile domain/planner types, semantic config/gate/template/projection adapters, path checks, errors/results, and owned unit/property tests. Repository-view implementation and validation-reader migration are outside this task.

**Green landing:** Pure profile plans and dry-run representations are tested behind an internal API; lock acquisition, commands, and repository writes remain unchanged.
